response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (10+ years) senior engineer with strong software craftsmanship, testing, and distributed/low-latency systems background, but the core requirement of this role — hands-on modern C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms — is barely represented. His only professional C/C++ work was roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, with C++ absent from his current skills list; his recent decade is web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, D, React). There is also no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT/message brokers in an industrial context, OPC UA/Modbus protocols, or Azure. The event-driven GIS platform and high-throughput microservices work show relevant architectural instincts, but a C++-centric, industrial-cybersecurity-focused senior role would require substantial retooling.
strengths: 10+ years senior/staff-level experience, incl. high-throughput low-latency microservices
Event-driven, distributed architecture and DevOps/CI-CD depth; strong TDD and quality mindset
Proven mentoring, workshops, and technical communication skills
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~7 months, 2014–2015); C++ not in current skill set
No demonstrated IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No industrial automation, MQTT/message broker, OPC UA/Modbus, or Azure exposure
